atoms.b: Your ability to taste, hear, feel, see and smell depends on your ((++nervous_system favourite_food)).
Apart from your senses, your nervous system is ((++responsible useless)) for other things too.
Two important areas at the base of the brain are the ((++cerebellum toes)) and the ((++brain_stem feet)).
The cerebellum controls your ((++balance bacon)) and ((++posture ice_lolly)). This is useful for activities like surfing or yoga.
The brain stem controls all the ((++functions fudge)) that keep your body alive: like your breathing and heart rate.
